name: SHARP Gaussian Generation with Hard Depth Anchor
definition: A method to generate SHARP Gaussians for hole filling by bypassing the learned Alignment UNet and using completed camera-Z as the first depth channel, while using SHARP's monocular relative gap as a conservative second channel to maintain the five-channel decoder contract.
summary: SHARP Gaussian Generation with Hard Depth Anchor fills 3D Gaussian Splatting holes using explicit depth anchoring instead of learned generative priors.
